chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Faḍl al-Hāshimī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

"There are two rakʿahs from the sunnah which are not prayed in any place except in al-Madīnah, and they are prayed in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله before going out to the muṣallā on the two ʿEids. That applies only in al-Madīnah, because the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله performed it."

key_terms.فَعَلَهُ: He performed it; indicating the prophetic basis for the ruling.
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ: The Mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.
key_terms.ٱلْعِيدَيْنِ: The two ʿEids, ʿEid al-Fiṭr and ʿEid al-Aḍḥā.
key_terms.ٱلْمَدِينَةِ: Al-Madīnah, where this practice is specifically observed.
key_terms.ٱلْمُصَلَّى: The prayer ground to which people go for the ʿEid prayer.

ai.seo_question: What special ʿEid sunnah prayer is performed only in al-Madīnah before going to the muṣallā?
ai.summary: This hadith states a specific sunnah practice connected to the ʿEid prayer in al-Madīnah: two rakʿahs are performed in Masjid al-Rasul صلى الله عليه وآله before going out to the prayer ground. The ruling is presented as unique to al-Madīnah because it is based on the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1471 - Muhammad ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:

"There are two (units of prayer) from the Sunnah that are not performed in any place except in Medina, and they are prayed in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah (sw) on the two Eids before going out to the prayer ground. This is unique to Medina because the Messenger of Allah (sw) performed it”.
